wiki.title: Snowface
wiki.text:
Snowface is an NPC boss that can be found in the Misty Mountain, located in Shrouded Glade.

Dialogues

Appearances
Free Realms Holiday TV Spot
Misty Mountain
Free Realms Issue 12

Gallery

Trivia
Snowface is the only known exception that appears to be a completely frozen over treant, but it is unknown if he is actually a completely new type of treant or a frozen Briarwood treant.
